dominant_untreated_sequela: progressive loss of ambulation to wheelchair dependence; the motor-disability axis (cognition relatively spared for this axis)
evidence_basis: GeneReviews NBK1119 (Dystrophinopathies) Clinical Description: loss of independent ambulation, wheelchair use by early teens

dominant_untreated_sequela: infantile-onset profound generalised hypotonia and progressive muscle weakness (motor disability); cognition spared, so motor-only (not motor+cognitive)
evidence_basis: GeneReviews NBK1261 (Pompe Disease) Clinical Description: progressive muscle weakness and motor impairment; intellect typically normal

dominant_untreated_sequela: progressive COMBINED neurocognitive regression and motor/skeletal impairment (dysostosis multiplex, joint contractures)
evidence_basis: GeneReviews NBK1162 (MPS I) Clinical Description: progressive cognitive decline with motor and skeletal disease in the severe (Hurler) phenotype

dominant_untreated_sequela: untreated classic PKU: severe-to-profound, irreversible intellectual disability as the single dominant sequela
evidence_basis: GeneReviews NBK1504 (Phenylalanine Hydroxylase Deficiency): untreated classic PKU causes profound, irreversible intellectual disability

dominant_untreated_sequela: transfusion-dependent severe chronic anemia (the disease IS the anemia in its untreated natural history)
evidence_basis: MedGen clinical_definition: severe anemia from infancy requiring regular transfusion (transfusion-dependent beta-thalassemia / Cooley anemia)

dominant_untreated_sequela: HbH disease: chronic moderate hemolytic anemia (the surviving non-hydrops phenotype); Hb Bart hydrops lethality is captured separately on the mortality axis
evidence_basis: MedGen clinical_definition: HbH disease chronic hemolytic anemia of moderate severity

dominant_untreated_sequela: infantile neurovisceral form: severe progressive psychomotor and cognitive regression with loss of milestones
evidence_basis: GeneReviews NBK1370 (Acid Sphingomyelinase Deficiency, type A): rapidly progressive neurodegeneration, loss of motor and cognitive milestones

dominant_untreated_sequela: untreated/poorly-controlled classic MSUD survivors: severe intellectual disability / neurological impairment (acute metabolic lethality scored separately on the mortality axis)
evidence_basis: MedGen clinical_definition: without treatment, neurological damage and intellectual disability

dominant_untreated_sequela: severe hemophilia A untreated: recurrent hemarthroses leading to chronic hemophilic arthropathy as the dominant functional sequela (treatment benefit scored separately via R_treat)
evidence_basis: GeneReviews NBK1404 (Hemophilia A): recurrent joint bleeding leads to progressive, disabling arthropathy without prophylaxis

dominant_untreated_sequela: severe hemophilia B untreated: recurrent hemarthroses leading to chronic hemophilic arthropathy as the dominant functional sequela (treatment benefit scored separately via R_treat)
evidence_basis: GeneReviews NBK1495 (Hemophilia B): recurrent joint bleeding leads to progressive, disabling arthropathy without prophylaxis
